decisions.reason: The source message separately confirms the touch-interface configuration, and a complete same-message MODIFY already records its push-pull active-HIGH output, R20/R25 pull-downs, and disconnected LOW state.
The button changes are a separate clause rather than a consequence of the PIR change, and they are already fully represented by a same-message MODIFY.
The source discusses GPIO buttons, PIR, touch, VRTC, and VBACKUP but does not change the panel reset interface.
The PIR sensor output and pull-down confirmation does not alter the addressable LED supply, data drive, selected part, or level-shifting requirements.
The PIR electrical-interface clarification does not change the sensor board's connector matrix or board role.
Confirming the AM312 as a push-pull active-HIGH device does not change the established sensor-board policy that current sensors need no level shifter and future 5V-logic sensors use an adapter.
The source does not discuss the SPS30 SEL connection or its I2C operating mode.
The PIR pull-down clarification has no effect on the e-paper backlight's power, switching, PWM, or passive-component configuration.
The source does not add, remove, or modify any integrated-board sensor connector.
The PIR interface clarification does not affect the LED array board's count, component selection, package, or connector requirements.
The source contains no change to the passive buzzer's type, package, voltage support, or approved part policy.
The PIR bias and output clarification does not change the switched 5V rail, whose defined loads remain the SPS30 and ZE08 sensors; no PIR power-rail reassignment is stated.
